parameters.help_en: The ID of the Application Load Balancing (ALB) instance listener
parameters.help_zh: 应用型负载均衡实例监听ID
parameters.name: listener_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId value as the ClientToken value. The RequestId value is different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run, without performing the actual request. Valid values:

true: performs only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error code is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): performs a dry run and performs the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, an `HTTP 2xx` status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会创建转发规则。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回`HTTP 2xx`状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The priority of the forwarding rule. Valid values: 1 to 10000. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

The priority of each rule within a listener must be unique
parameters.help_zh:
规则优先级，取值范围：1~10000。值越小表示优先级越高。

同一个监听内规则优先级必须唯一
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en:
The direction of the forwarding rule. Valid values:

Request (default): The rule matches requests sent from clients to ALB and performs the corresponding actions.

Response: The rule matches responses returned from backend server groups to ALB and performs the corresponding actions.

ALB instances of Basic Edition do not support the Response type
parameters.help_zh:
转发规则的方向。取值：

Request（默认值）：请求类型，对从客户端发送到ALB的报文进行条件匹配并进行相应的处理。

Response：响应类型，对从后端服务器组返回到ALB的报文进行条件匹配并进行相应的处理。

基础版的ALB实例不支持Response类型
parameters.name: direction

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether credentials are allowed. Valid values:

on: allowed.
off: not allowed
fields.help_zh:
是否允许携带凭证信息。取值：

on：是。
off：否
fields.name: allow_credentials

fields.help_en: The list of headers allowed for CORS requests
fields.help_zh: 允许跨域的Header列表
fields.name: allow_headers

fields.help_en: The HTTP methods allowed for CORS requests
fields.help_zh: 选择跨域访问时允许的HTTP方法
fields.name: allow_methods

fields.help_en:
The list of allowed origins. You can configure a single element `*`, or configure one or more values.
Each value must start with `http://` or `https://`, followed by a valid domain name or a first-level wildcard domain name (for example, `http://*.test.abc.example.com`).
Each value can optionally include a port. The port range is 1 to 65535
fields.help_zh:
允许的访问来源列表。支持只配置一个元素`*`，或配置一个或多个值。
单个值必须以`http://`或者`https://`开头，后边加一个正确的域名或一级泛域名。（例：`http://*.test.abc.example.com`）
单个值可以不加端口，也可以指定端口，端口范围：1~65535
fields.name: allow_origin

fields.help_en: The list of headers that can be exposed
fields.help_zh: 允许暴露的Header列表
fields.name: expose_headers

fields.help_en:
The maximum cache time for preflight requests in the browser. Unit: seconds.

Valid values: -1 to 172800
fields.help_zh:
预检请求在浏览器的最大缓存时间，单位：秒。

取值范围：-1~172800
fields.name: max_age

fields.help_en: The CORS configuration
fields.help_zh: 跨域
fields.name: cors_config

fields.help_en: The fixed content to return. The content can be up to 1 KB in size and can contain only ASCII characters
fields.help_zh: 返回的固定内容。最大支持存储1 KB，只支持ASCII字符
fields.name: content

fields.help_en:
The format of the fixed content.

Valid values: text/plain, text/css, text/html, application/javascript, and application/json
fields.help_zh:
返回固定内容的格式。

取值：text/plain、text/css、text/html、application/javascript或application/json
fields.name: content_type

fields.help_en: The HTTP response code to return. Only 2xx, 4xx, and 5xx numeric strings are supported, where x is any digit
fields.help_zh: 返回的HTTP响应码，仅支持2xx、4xx、5xx数字型字符串，x为任意数字
fields.name: http_code

fields.help_en: The configuration of the fixed response
fields.help_zh: 固定响应内容配置
fields.name: fixed_response_config

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable session persistence. Valid values:

true: enabled.
false (default): disabled
fields.help_zh:
是否开启会话保持。取值：

true：开启。
false（默认值）：不开启
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The timeout period. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 1 to 86400. Default value: 1000
fields.help_zh: 超时时间。单位：秒。取值范围：1~86400。默认值：1000
fields.name: timeout

fields.help_en: The session persistence configuration between server groups
fields.help_zh: 服务器组之间会话保持
fields.name: server_group_sticky_session

fields.help_en: The destination server group to which requests are forwarded
fields.help_zh: 转发到的目的服务器组
fields.name: server_group_id

fields.help_en:
The weight. A larger value indicates a higher weight, which means more requests are forwarded to the server group. Valid values: 0 to 100.

If only one destination server group is specified and no weight is specified, the default value is 100.

If more than one destination server group is specified, you must specify the weight value
fields.help_zh:
权重。取值越大，权重越大，表示转发的访问请求更多。取值范围：0~100。

目的服务器组数为1时，未指定权重时默认值为100。

目的服务器组数大于1时，需要用户指定权重值
fields.name: weight

fields.help_en: The list of destination server groups to which requests are forwarded. A maximum of 5 destination server groups can be added to a forwarding rule
fields.help_zh: 转发到的目的服务器组列表。一条转发规则中最多支持添加5个目的服务器组
fields.name: server_group_tuples

fields.help_en: The list of destination server groups to which requests are forwarded. A maximum of 5 destination server groups can be added to a forwarding rule
fields.help_zh: 转发到的目的服务器组列表。一条转发规则中最多支持添加5个目的服务器组
fields.name: forward_group_config

fields.help_en:
The name of the header field to insert. The name must be 1 to 40 characters in length and can contain lowercase and uppercase letters a to z, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The header field name specified in InsertHeaderConfig must be unique.

You cannot set the header name to the following fields (case-insensitive): `slb-id`, `slb-ip`, `x-forwarded-for`, `x-forwarded-proto`, `x-forwarded-eip`, `x-forwarded-port`, `x-forwarded-client-srcport`, `connection`, `upgrade`, `content-length`, `transfer-encoding`, `keep-alive`, `te`, `host`, `cookie`, `remoteip`, `authority`, `x-forwarded-host`
fields.help_zh:
插入的头字段名称，长度为1\~40个字符，支持大小写字母a\~z、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。InsertHeaderConfig中的头字段名称不能重复。

不允许将头名称设置为以下字段（不区分大小写）：`slb-id`、`slb-ip`、`x-forwarded-for`、`x-forwarded-proto`、`x-forwarded-eip`、`x-forwarded-port`、`x-forwarded-client-srcport`、`connection`、`upgrade`、`content-length`、`transfer-encoding`、`keep-alive`、`te`、`host`、`cookie`、`remoteip`、`authority`、`x-forwarded-host`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the header field to insert.

If ValueType is set to SystemDefined, valid values are:
    - ClientSrcPort: the client port.
    - ClientSrcIp: the client IP address.
    - Protocol: the protocol used by the client request (HTTP or HTTPS).
    - SLBId: the Application Load Balancing instance ID.
    - SLBPort: the Application Load Balancing instance listener port.
If ValueType is set to UserDefined: you can specify a custom header value. The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain wildcards asterisks (*), question marks (?), and printable characters in the ASCII range `ch >= 32 && ch < 127`. The value cannot contain `"`. The value cannot start or end with a space. The value cannot end with `\`.
If ValueType is set to ReferenceHeader: you can reference a field in the request header. The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain lowercase letters a to z, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
fields.help_zh:
插入的头字段内容。

ValueType取值为SystemDefined时取值如下：
    - ClientSrcPort：客户端端口。
    - ClientSrcIp：客户端IP地址。
    - Protocol：客户端请求的协议（HTTP或HTTPS)。
    - SLBId：应用型负载均衡实例ID。
    - SLBPort：应用型负载均衡实例监听端口。
ValueType取值为UserDefined时：您可自定义头字段内容，限制长度为1~128个字符，支持通配符星号（*）、半角问号（?）和ASCII码值`ch >= 32 && ch < 127`范围内的可打印字符，不支持`"`。开头和结尾不能为空格。结尾不能为`\`。
ValueType取值为ReferenceHeader时：您可以引用请求头字段中的某一个字段，限制长度限制为1\~128个字符，支持小写字母a\~z、数字、短划线（-）和下划线（_）
fields.name: value

fields.help_en:
The content type of the header field value. Valid values:

UserDefined: a custom value.

ReferenceHeader: references a field in the request header.

SystemDefined: a system-defined value
fields.help_zh:
头字段内容类型。取值：

UserDefined：您自定义头字段内容。

ReferenceHeader：引用请求头中的某一个头字段内容。

SystemDefined：系统定义头字段内容
fields.name: value_type

fields.help_en: The configuration for inserting a header field
fields.help_zh: 写入头字段配置
fields.name: insert_header_config

fields.help_en: The order in which the forwarding rule action is executed. Valid values: 1 to 50000. Actions are executed in ascending order of values. This parameter cannot be left empty and the value cannot be duplicated
fields.help_zh: 转发规则动作执行的顺序，取值范围：1~50000，按值从小到大执行动作。值不能为空，不能重复
fields.name: order

fields.help_en:
The host to which requests are redirected. Valid values:
${host} (default): This value cannot be concatenated with other characters.
Other values. Character set and format restrictions are as follows:
    - The hostname must be 3 to 256 characters in length and can contain lowercase letters a to z, digits, hyphens (-), periods (.), and wildcards asterisks (*), equals signs (=), tildes (~), underscores (_), plus signs (+), backslashes (), carets (^), exclamation marks (!), dollar signs ($), ampersands (&), vertical bars (|), parentheses (()), brackets ([]), and question marks (?).
    - The hostname must contain at least one period (.) and cannot start or end with a period (.).
    - The rightmost domain label can contain only letters and wildcards, and cannot contain digits or hyphens (-). The leftmost `domainlable` can be an asterisk (*).
    - Hyphens (-) cannot appear at the beginning or end of other domain labels.
    - Wildcards asterisks (*) and question marks (?) can appear at any position in a domain label
fields.help_zh:
要跳转的主机地址。取值：
${host}（默认值）：取此值时不支持和其他字符拼接使用。
其他取值，字符集和格式限制如下：
    - 主机名长度为3\~256个字符，支持小写字母a\~z、数字、短划线（-）、半角句号（.）以及通配符星号（*）、等号（=）、波浪线（~）、下划线（_）、加号（+）、反斜线（\）、脱字号（^）、感叹号（!）、美元符号（$）、and（&）、竖线（|）、半角圆括号（()）、方括号（[]）和半角问号（?）。
    - 主机名至少包含一个半角句号（.），且半角句号（.）不能出现在开头或结尾。
    - 最右侧的域标签只能包含字母和通配符，不能包含数字或短划线（-），最左侧`domainlable`允许是星号（*）。
    - 短划线（-）不能出现在其它域标签的开头或结尾。
    -  通配符星号（*）和半角问号（?）可以出现在域标签的任意位置
fields.name: host

fields.help_en: The redirect type. Valid values: 301, 302, 303, 307, and 308
fields.name: http_code

fields.help_en:
The path to which requests are redirected. Valid values:
${path} (default): You can reference ${host}, ${protocol}, and ${port}. Each variable can appear at most once. These variables can be used together or concatenated with characters within the allowed character set described below.
Other values. Character set and format restrictions are as follows:
    - The value must be 1 to 256 characters in length, is case-sensitive, and supports wildcards asterisks (*) and question marks (?) as wildcards.
    - The value must start with a forward slash (/), and can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, and special characters `$-_.+/&~@:'*?`. The value cannot contain `"%#;!()[]^,"\"`. Wildcards asterisks (*) and question marks (?) are supported
fields.help_zh:
要跳转的路径。取值：
${path}（默认值）：可以引用 ${host}、${protocol}和${port}，每个变量最多出现一次。上述变量可以同时使用，也可以和下面罗列的可取值范围内的字符串拼接使用。
其他取值，字符集和格式限制如下：
    - 长度为1\~256个字符，大小写敏感，支持通配符星号（*）和半角问号（?）作为通配符使用。
    - 必须以正斜线（/）开头，支持大小写字母、数字和特殊字符`$-_.+/&~@:'*?`，不支持`“%#;!()[]^,”\"`，同时支持通配符星号（*）和半角问号（?）
fields.name: path

fields.help_en:
The port to which requests are redirected.
${port} (default): This value cannot be used together with other characters.
Other values: 1 to 63335
fields.help_zh:
要跳转的端口。
${port}（默认值）：该取值不支持和其他字符同时使用。
其他取值：1~63335
fields.name: port

fields.help_en:
The protocol to which requests are redirected. Valid values:
${protocol} (default): This value can only be used alone and cannot be modified or concatenated with other characters.
HTTP
HTTPS

HTTPS listeners support redirection to HTTPS only.
HTTP listeners support redirection to both HTTP and HTTPS
fields.help_zh:
要跳转的协议。取值：
${protocol}（默认值）：取该值时仅支持单独使用，不支持修改或与其他字符拼接使用。
HTTP
HTTPS

HTTPS监听仅支持跳转HTTPS协议。
HTTP监听支持跳转HTTP和HTTPS协议
fields.name: protocol

fields.help_en:
The query string to which requests are redirected.
${query} (default): You can reference ${host}, ${protocol}, and ${port}. Each variable can appear at most once. These variables can be used together or concatenated with characters within the allowed character set described below.
Other values. Character set and format restrictions are as follows:
    - The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length.
    - The value can contain printable characters but cannot contain spaces or `#[]{}\|<>"`. Letters must be lowercase
fields.help_zh:
要跳转的查询字符串。
${query}（默认值）：可以引用 ${host}、${protocol}和${port}，每个变量最多出现一次。上述变量可以同时使用，也可以和下面罗列的可取值范围内的字符串拼接使用。
其他取值，字符集和格式限制如下：
    - 长度为1\~128个字符。
    - 支持可见字符，不支持空格和 `#[]{}\|<>"`。如果是字母则必须是小写字母
fields.name: query

fields.help_en:
The redirect configuration.

For the parameters in RedirectConfig, parameters other than httpCode cannot all use default values
fields.help_zh:
重定向配置。

RedirectConfig的参数，除了httpCode外，不能都使用默认值
fields.name: redirect_config

fields.help_en:
The name of the header field to remove. The name must be 1 to 40 characters in length and can contain uppercase and lowercase letters a to z, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The header field name cannot be duplicated in RemoveHeader.

Request direction (Direction is set to Request): You cannot set the header name to the following fields (case-insensitive): `slb-id`, `slb-ip`, `x-forwarded-for`, `x-forwarded-proto`, `x-forwarded-eip`, `x-forwarded-port`, `x-forwarded-client-srcport`, `connection`, `upgrade`, `content-length`, `transfer-encoding`, `keep-alive`, `te`, `host`, `cookie`, `remoteip`, `authority`, `x-forwarded-host`.
Response direction (Direction is set to Response): You cannot set the header name to the following fields (case-insensitive): `connection`, `upgrade`, `content-length`, `transfer-encoding`
fields.help_zh:
去除的头字段名称，长度为1~40个字符，支持大小写字母a~z、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。头字段名称不能重复用于RemoveHeader中。

请求方向（Direction取值为Request）：不允许将头名称设置为以下字段（不区分大小写）：`slb-id`、`slb-ip`、`x-forwarded-for`、`x-forwarded-proto`、`x-forwarded-eip`、`x-forwarded-port`、`x-forwarded-client-srcport`、`connection`、`upgrade`、`content-length`、`transfer-encoding`、`keep-alive`、`te`、`host`、`cookie`、`remoteip`、`authority`、`x-forwarded-host`。
响应方向（Direction取值为Response）：响应方向不允许将头名称设置为以下字段（不区分大小写）：`connection`、`upgrade`、`content-length`、`transfer-encoding`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The configuration for removing an HTTP header field
fields.help_zh: 去除HTTP头部配置
fields.name: remove_header_config

fields.help_en:
The destination hostname for internal redirection. Valid values:
${host} (default): This value cannot be concatenated with other characters.

Other values. Character set and format restrictions are as follows:

    - The hostname must be 3 to 256 characters in length and can contain lowercase letters a to z, digits, hyphens (-), periods (.), and wildcards asterisks (*), equals signs (=), tildes (~), underscores (_), plus signs (+), backslashes (), carets (^), exclamation marks (!), dollar signs ($), ampersands (&), vertical bars (|), parentheses (()), brackets ([]), and question marks (?).

    - The hostname must contain at least one period (.) and cannot start or end with a period (.).

    - The rightmost domain label can contain only letters and wildcards, and cannot contain digits or hyphens (-). The leftmost `domainlable` can be an asterisk (*).

    - Hyphens (-) cannot appear at the beginning or end of other domain labels. Wildcards asterisks (*) and question marks (?) can appear at any position in a domain label
fields.help_zh:
内部跳转的目的主机地址。取值：
${host}（默认值）：该取值不支持和其他字符拼接。

其他取值，字符格式限制如下：

    - 主机名长度为3\~256个字符，支持小写字母a\~z、数字、短划线（-）、半角句号（.）以及通配符星号（*）、等号（=）、波浪线（~）、下划线（_）、加号（+）、反斜线（\）、脱字号（^）、感叹号（!）、美元符号（$）、and（&）、竖线（|）、半角圆括号（()）、方括号（[]）和半角问号（?）。

    - 主机名至少包含一个半角句号（.），且半角句号（.）不能出现在开头或结尾。

    - 最右侧的域标签只能包含字母和通配符，不能包含数字或短划线（-），最左侧`domainlable`允许是星号（*）。

    - 短划线（-）不能出现在其它域标签的开头或结尾。通配符星号（*）和半角问号（？）可以出现在域标签的任意位置
fields.name: host

fields.help_en:
The path to which requests are redirected. Valid values:
${path} (default): You can reference ${host}, ${protocol}, and ${port}. Each variable can appear at most once. These variables can be used together or concatenated with characters within the allowed character set described below.
Other values. Character set and format restrictions are as follows:
    - The value must be 1 to 256 characters in length, is case-sensitive, and supports wildcards asterisks (*) and question marks (?) as wildcards.
    - The value must start with a forward slash (/), and can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, and special characters `$-_.+/&~@:'*?`. The value cannot contain `"%#;!()[]^,"\"`. Wildcards asterisks (*) and question marks (?) are supported
fields.help_zh:
要跳转的路径。取值：
${path}（默认值）：可以引用 ${host}、${protocol}和${port}，每个变量最多出现一次。上述变量可以同时使用，也可以和下面罗列的可取值范围内的字符串拼接使用。
其他取值，字符集和格式限制如下：
    - 长度为1\~256个字符，大小写敏感，支持通配符星号（*）和半角问号（?）作为通配符使用。
    - 必须以正斜线（/）开头，支持大小写字母、数字和特殊字符`$-_.+/&~@:'*?`，不支持`“%#;!()[]^,”\"`，同时支持通配符星号（*）和半角问号（?）
fields.name: path

fields.help_en:
The query string for internal redirection.
${query} (default): You can reference ${host}, ${protocol}, and ${port}. Each variable can appear at most once. These variables can be used together or concatenated with characters within the allowed character set described below.
Other values. Character set and format restrictions are as follows:
    - The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length.
    - The value can contain printable characters but cannot contain spaces or `#[]{}\|<>"`. Letters must be lowercase
fields.help_zh:
内部跳转的查询字符串。
${query}（默认值）：可以引用 ${host}、${protocol}和${port}，每个变量最多出现一次。上述变量可以同时使用，也可以和下面罗列的可取值范围内的字符串拼接使用。
